name: Wizard OS 0.3.103-bt389.5 — REHEARSAL ONLY (wizard-os 389): 0.3.102 + browser-trust draft stacks
about: Rehearsal candidate for card 6 (wizard-os 389), never published: 0.3.102 plus the browser-isolation draft stacks at their heads. Images are local builds of the exact GitHub commits below, served from a loopback-only rehearsal registry. Not a release.

modes.fresh: blank Ubuntu/Debian box: Runtipi + App Manager + the default app in every spot (including hermes-agent)
modes.alongside: box that already runs Hermes (run as its owner): App Manager + apps + the Wizard shell pointed at that Hermes; `wizard link` connects it, `wizard unlink` reverses it byte for byte

install.note: Fresh and alongside installs both take every default app at the source commit pinned below, and the Wizard UX and Agent Service images at the digests above; the installer reads back what runs (a default app on another source commit fails; index versions are informational and reported as drift).
